# uptrace_email_channel (Resource)

Manages an Uptrace email notification channel. It addresses project members, not addresses: everyone, or the listed teams and users. Only members of the channel's project receive the email.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptrace_org" "example" {
  name = "My Organization"
}

resource "uptrace_project" "example" {
  org_id = uptrace_org.example.id
  name   = "api"
}

# Email every member of the project.
resource "uptrace_email_channel" "everyone" {
  project_id = uptrace_project.example.id
  name       = "alerts-email"
  priorities = ["high"]
  everyone   = true
}

resource "uptrace_team" "oncall" {
  org_id = uptrace_org.example.id
  name   = "oncall"
}

resource "uptrace_team_project" "oncall" {
  org_id     = uptrace_org.example.id
  team_id    = uptrace_team.oncall.id
  project_id = uptrace_project.example.id
}

# Email the members of one team.
resource "uptrace_email_channel" "oncall" {
  project_id = uptrace_project.example.id
  name       = "oncall-email"
  priorities = ["high", "medium"]
  team_ids   = [uptrace_team.oncall.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Human-readable channel name.
- `priorities` (List of String) Alert priorities to match. Valid values: info, low, medium, high.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID this channel belongs to. Changing this forces recreation.

### Optional

- `condition` (String) Alert condition expression.
- `everyone` (Boolean) Email every member of the project, resolved on each delivery, so a later member is included. Conflicts with team_ids and user_ids.
- `match_all` (Boolean) Match all monitors. If false, monitor_ids must be provided.
- `monitor_ids` (Set of String) Monitor IDs to match when match_all is false. Omit to leave the links alone, as when monitors name the channel in their channel_ids; set [] to detach every monitor.
- `team_ids` (Set of String) IDs of the teams whose members get the email. Set everyone, or at least one of team_ids and user_ids.
- `user_ids` (Set of String) IDs of the users who get the email. Set everyone, or at least one of team_ids and user_ids.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Channel ID.
- `status` (String) Channel status (delivering, paused, disabled, draft).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import uptrace_email_channel.example 1:42
```
